【原视频简介】
Growing an avocado bonsai from seed – this timelapse shows the entire process over 378 days. The seed came out of a regular grocery store avocado and went through germination, the first leaves, root pruning, repotting into a shallow pot and cutting back the trunk to force branching. The result is a small avocado bonsai tree that still shows what a year of growth looks like when you compress it into a few minutes.

Timelapse plant growth videos like this one are shot with a camera taking a photo every few minutes, day and night, for the full duration of the project. All of my timelapses start from seeds you can buy in any supermarket – avocado, mango, pomegranate, lemon and more – and follow the plant from seed to tree, seed to fruit or, in this case, seed to bonsai.

#timelapse #avocado #bonsai #plantgrowth #growingfromseed
